title: Lines Needed to Change the Recorded Mask Style (PAP Supply Replenishment Program)
content:
**Rule.** When the interface style in use is read from an enrollment's lines in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, the counted lines of the candidate cushion item needed to change the record are:

- **two** when the patient also collected the interface that goes with the candidate's style within the span;
- **three** when that interface was collected only before the span.

Where the patient never collected that interface, no lowered count applies under this rule.

## Terms

- **The interface that goes with the candidate's style:** a nasal interface (A7034) for the nasal or nasal pillows style; a full face mask (A7030) for the full face style.
- **Collected:** bought as a self-pay line and picked up at a Summit Ridge branch.
- **Within the span:** shipped inside the span read back from the handling day for the style reading; **only before the span:** collected at some time, but not within the span.

## Table

| Matching interface collected at a branch | Lines of the candidate needed |
|---|---|
| within the span | 2 |
| only before the span | 3 |
| never | no lowered count |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- Candidate: pillow pairs (nasal pillows style) with 2 counted lines; the patient collected a nasal interface A7034 at a branch inside the span: 2 lines are needed and 2 are present, so the style changes to nasal pillows.
- Same, but the A7034 was collected four months before the span: 3 lines are needed; 2 are not enough.
- Candidate: full face cushion with 3 counted lines; a full face mask A7030 was collected only before the span: 3 lines needed and present, so the style changes to full face.
